thread:
Maya Chen: Heads up — Peregrine Labs (dedicated trial) showing a sudden usage freeze starting Friday. Daily token volume down ~92% vs baseline, two power users silent. Escalating to CS/Eng to triage.
Jordan Lee: Got it. Can you drop a last-7d snapshot and any recent client errors? I'll check infra & deploys.
Maya Chen: quick snapshot — pasted from billing/telemetry: 
```
last_7_days_tokens:
  2026-03-17: 12400
  2026-03-18: 11890
  2026-03-19: 900
  2026-03-20: 850
  2026-03-21: 400
  2026-03-22: 300
  2026-03-23: 950
top_users: alice@peregrine, bob@peregrine
note: spike to normal on 3/23 was a single backfill job (cron).
```
Ravi Patel: FYI I spoke with their AE (Friday AM) — they mentioned a competitor PoC (NimbusAI) and procurement evaluating cost. They also said ops ran a key rotation Friday afternoon.
Jordan Lee: checking logs now — no deploys on our side. I see repeated 401s for their client key around 3/20 14:12 UTC, followed by a flood of retries and eventual backoff. No runtime OOMs or model failures.
Maya Chen: Support ticket #45321 documents the rotate + 401s. They reverted the rotation but usage never fully recovered. Ticket thread: "user reported auth failing after automated key rotate; they reissued key and confirmed calls succeed but lower traffic."
Peregrine Support Bot: [automated] Customer heartbeats: last successful heartbeat 2026-03-23T02:04:12Z; sentiment: neutral.
Sam Rodriguez: Thanks — sounds like two simultaneous causes: 1) Key rotation causing immediate client failures, 2) procurement/competitive evaluation decreasing volume. Short-term: we should unblock auth + run a quick re-onboard. Medium-term: re-secure usage via value play & offer runway. Proposed plan:
  - Technical: schedule 30–45m re-onboard with SDK engineer to validate keys, retry logic, and any integration gaps.
  - Commercial: offer a 30k token credit and a micro-pilot with a lower-cost model variant to keep them live while procurement evaluates Nimbus.
  - Ops: ask procurement contact for timeline and whether Nimbus pilot is full-stack or just eval.
Ravi Patel: I'll ping the procurement contact and their new PM (cc'd in my CRM). If they move to Nimbus, it's likely for price delta — we should surface Optimize suggestions + cost comparison.
Jordan Lee: Actionable tech notes for the re-onboard: confirm SDK versions, check Client-Side backoff, ensure idempotency keys, and look at any proxy/nginx 4xx chunks. I'll prepare a checklist.
Maya Chen: I'm booking re-onboard for Wed 2026-03-25 10:00 PT. @Ravi please confirm decision-maker/infra owner can join. @Jordan please bring the checklist + a short demo of retry pattern.
Ravi Patel: Confirmed — I'll try to get both the infra lead (Liam) and procurement (Sara) to attend.
Sam Rodriguez: Also prepare a short ROI slide showing token/unit economics vs Nimbus (call out batching & caching benefits). If procurement wants numbers, hand them to Sales.
Maya Chen: Next steps captured: (1) Re-onboard session Wed 10am PT (Maya/Jordan/Ravi + Peregrine attendees), (2) 30k token credit offer drafted by Sales, (3) support to close ticket #45321 with root-cause notes, (4) follow-up sync 48h after session to check usage rebound.
Jordan Lee: I'll attach the checklist and observed 401 traces to the support ticket before the session.
Maya Chen: Thanks team. Will post calendar invite and update CS playbook entry if this pattern repeats (:eyes:).
Ravi Patel: I'll update the account page with the competitive flag so AE/SDR know to monitor.
Sam Rodriguez: Marking as high-priority renewal watch — next review in 7 days.
Maya Chen: Closing here for now — will reopen thread if anything new pops up.
